episodes.synopsis: Arusu passes her days at school wishing she had magical powers.
episodes.title: Country of Witches

episodes.synopsis: When  Arusu tries to learn how to ride a broomstick, she frees one hundred  imprisoned fairies, creating a crisis in the Magical Realm.
episodes.title: One-Hundred Sprites

episodes.synopsis: Arusu, Sheila, and Eva head off to capture the hundred fairies and lift the Curse of Eternal Youth.
episodes.title: Magic Broom

episodes.synopsis: Arusu encounters an Ecoo Fairy, who will grant her a single wish.
episodes.title: Sprite-War

episodes.synopsis: Arusu seeks a way back to the Human Realm, but discovers her book of spells is not just any old book.
episodes.title: Demon Led Book

episodes.synopsis: Arusu must acquire the feather of a griffin.  Can she figure out a way to do it without robbing the fairy of its freedom?
episodes.title: Griffin's Feather

episodes.synopsis: With many of the fairies still missing, Sheila struggles to teach the Apprentice. Eva helps Arusu find another route to the Human Realm.
episodes.title: Pisky's Tusk

episodes.synopsis: Arusu and Eva get lost in the Forest of No Return, which tests their magical abilities to the limits.
episodes.title: Forest of No Return

episodes.synopsis: With the Witch Evaluations looming,  the Apprentice Witches stress over the biggest test of their lives.
episodes.title: Petrification Spell

episodes.synopsis: The Witch Evaluations are interrupted by a vengeful fairy.
episodes.title: Large Flood

episodes.synopsis: The arrival of an uninvited guest opens old wounds for Sheila.
episodes.title: Witch Tradition

episodes.synopsis: The group searches for Sheila after she runs away from home, but there are unintended consequences for Arusu.
episodes.title: Happy Birthday

episodes.synopsis: Arusu's pledge to only use magic to help people is put to the test during a deadly encounter.
episodes.title: Witch Sigma

episodes.synopsis: Arusu and Eva help the fairies ward off the warlocks. Sheila questions her future as a witch.
episodes.title: Sheila's Doubts

episodes.synopsis: Sigma works to gain the group's trust.
episodes.title: Cursed Magic

episodes.synopsis: Eva flies to the Dark Caves to find the flower that can save Sheila and Arusu's lives.
episodes.title: Eva's Courage

episodes.synopsis: Arusu, Sheila, and Eva disguise themselves as men to enter the Wizard Kingdom.
episodes.title: Infiltration! Demon World

episodes.synopsis: Arusu is rescued by a wizard named Will, a rebel warlock who has answers to questions Arusu has asked her entire life.
episodes.title: True Wizard

episodes.synopsis: Sigma reveals a dark, dangerous secret that could save the world.
episodes.title: Desperate Situation

episodes.synopsis: Arusu tries to convince Sheila and Eva to form the Magic-Girl Squad, a group devoted to protecting the fairies from the Warlocks.
episodes.title: Magic-Girl Squad

episodes.synopsis: Arusu travels along the Interdimensional Sea to the Human Realm.
episodes.title: Interdimensional Sea

episodes.synopsis: The exiled witches face a stiff challenge: using magic once again.
episodes.title: Pirate Lennon

episodes.synopsis: Sheila begins her search for the witch who uses black magic.
episodes.title: Witch of Betrayal

episodes.synopsis: Sheila and Arusu's relationship thaws as Sheila returns to the Magical Realm.
episodes.title: Light of Hope

episodes.synopsis: The Magic-Girl Squad works to unravel the mysteries of Lennon's past.
episodes.title: Doubt

episodes.synopsis: In the Warlock Prison, Sigma discovers his cellmate might have the answers to some very important questions.
episodes.title: Broken Heart

episodes.synopsis: The Warlocks step up their search for the remaining fairies and for the True Book of Spells.
episodes.title: Omen of Destruction

episodes.synopsis: As the Warlocks near Witch Heaven, Atelia rallies her fellow witches to fight for their freedom.
episodes.title: Full Attack

episodes.synopsis: The responsibilities of protecting the True Book of Spells take their toll on Arusu.
episodes.title: True Demon-Led Book

episodes.synopsis: When Lennon confronts Atelia, the shocking secrets of his past affect everyone in the Magical Realm.
episodes.title: Lennon's True Character

episodes.synopsis: When Atelia weakens, a power struggle emerges amongst the witches of the Magical Realm.
episodes.title: Painful Thoughts

episodes.synopsis: Armed with valuable information, Sigma attempts to bargain his freedom.
episodes.title: One Should Protect the Truth

episodes.synopsis: Atelia takes a stand, and Arusu formulates a plan to rescue her father--but at what cost?
episodes.title: Papa is Alive

episodes.synopsis: As Arusu and Lennon travel to Wizard Kingdom to exchange the True Book of Spells,Sheila and Eva race to stop her.
episodes.title: Promise

episodes.synopsis: Arusu comes face-to-face with the ominous leader of the Warlocks.
episodes.title: Collapse

episodes.synopsis: Arusu learns she has the power to save the Magical Realm, but with the world crumbling around her, will she have time to save it?
episodes.title: Escape

episodes.synopsis: In the wake of the destruction of Wizard Kingdom, Arusu struggles to harness the Magic of Light.
episodes.title: Demise

episodes.synopsis: Sheila proposes an unconventional plan to save Witch Heaven.
episodes.title: Black Magic

episodes.synopsis: The power of Dark Magic is unleashed--from an incredibly unlikely source.
episodes.title: Magic of Light

episodes.synopsis: In order to save the Magical Realm, Arusu journeys to where it all began: the Human Realm.
episodes.title: Hope
